purpose: Imagine the high degree of another person’s feeling.
keywords: express feelings speak politely show respect
さぞ + emotion / evaluation + だろう / でしょう / ことだろう
You must be delighted to have passed.
You must be very tired after the long journey.
Waiting alone must have felt terribly lonely.
formation: さぞ + emotion / evaluation + だろう / でしょう / ことだろう
mistake: It expresses sympathetic conjecture rather than direct knowledge.
